headline: MADAME (C) jumps 9.52% intraday as its CB trading sign is lifted.
market_take: Property and food stocks led today’s activity, with several securities posting sharp price gaps and volume spikes. TWPC (food) recorded a 14.6σ volume surge and JCK (prop) a 10.7σ spike, while TRITN (cons) suffered a -33.33% open gap, the largest 5‑day mover. Earnings filings were concentrated in REITs and construction materials, notably GVREIT and TPOLY.

sector_notes.note: MADAME rallied 9.52% intraday after its CB sign was lifted; XBIO fell 12.5% intraday with 2.11× volume; TWPC saw a 14.6σ volume spike despite a -7.14% intraday decline.
PF dropped 20% on an open gap; JCK surged 8.33% on an open gap and logged a 10.7σ volume spike; KC and KUN posted double‑digit declines with modest volume.
TRITN experienced a -33.33% open gap, the biggest 5‑day mover; PLE rose 14.29% intraday; SOLAR slipped 8.33% intraday.
GVREIT released multiple Q3 earnings filings; CPNREIT filed Q2 earnings; QHOP showed a -100% price gap, indicating possible suspension.
PPPM recorded a 3.3σ volume spike and fell 7.41%; NER posted a 4.8σ volume spike.

watchlist.reason: CB sign lifted and +9.52% intraday move.
-20% open gap; price pressure in property.

risk_flags: CB sign changes on MADAME may affect short‑term liquidity.
Large price gaps in TRITN and PF suggest heightened volatility.
Extreme volume spikes in TWPC and JCK could precede news‑driven moves.
QHOP's -100% price gap signals possible trading suspension.
Overall market shows mixed direction with property sector under pressure.
